name: Annealed LPCVD SiN (high-stress category)

sources.kind: Published Sellmeier n fit (0.310-5.504 um), then digitized fitted n and k curves from Fig. 1 (1.4-31.6 um).
sources.specimen: 340 nm LPCVD Si3N4 on 3.1 um thermal SiO2/silicon; annealed 3 h at 1200 C
sources.stress: Numerical residual stress of the optical-characterization sample not established

sources.kind: Measured LPCVD thermo-optic coefficient, Eq. (3), averaged over 1460-1550 nm
sources.sample_match: Stress and annealing state unspecified; transferred to the selected SiN formulation as an explicit approximation.
sources.construction: Integrate dn/dT from 300 K and add the selected material room-temperature n at 1550 nm. These are sampled fit values, not measured n(T) for this specimen.

borrowed_references.reason: Annealed LPCVD sample; numeric residual stress is not established.
Stress/annealing state not matched; only the thermo-optic increment is transferred.

digitization.missing_value_rule: Previously rounded graphical k=0 entries are blank here because these losses are unresolved, not measured zero.

notes: Nominal 300 K optical data; 1200 C is the prior anneal temperature, not a measurement temperature.
No measured k(T) is bundled. A configured Cataldo fallback may supply spectral gaps; it is not matched to this film.
Near-IR n at digitized-curve wavelengths is interpolated from the denser published Sellmeier sampling.
schema: temperature_k,wavelength_um,n,k; empty n or k means unknown
fallback_policy: The suggested file is used only when explicitly named by data.fallback_file in a configuration.
